intended_object: This is a pretty-printing helper, not a mathematical object. It is an app delaborator that makes Lean display `WithLp.toLp p x` as a function application instead of the structure-instance form `{ ofLp := x }`, as the docstring says.
explanation: The declaration is a `meta def` of type `Delab`, tagged `@[app_delab WithLp.toLp]`. It only affects how terms are printed, which is an implementation detail of the library's display, so it has no mathematical counterpart to compare against.
